method: One source photo, each encoding API in a fresh Node process. Cold import+first encode; one warm repeat except expensive score search. Animations contain one 100ms frame; layers one replacement layer; patches one pixel copied onto itself; splines one zero-amplitude curve. These are footprint/mode smoke measurements, not representative animation/patch/spline compression claims.

rows.timing: Node main thread. Cold includes module import/initialization plus first encode. Warm excludes input PNG decode and output file write.
rows.memoryMethod: Whole fresh Node process peak RSS (KiB), including decoded input, encoder, runtime and worker where used; not incremental codec allocation.

correctness.metricNote: ssimulacra2 uses the 8-bit decoded PNG, as in the common matrix. nativeStreamSsimulacra2 uses native float decoding of the JXL stream and avoids the extra PNG quantization step. Internal search metrics describe its reconstructed candidate.
